content: Sphinx i18n: gettext-standard workflow — 'make gettext' extracts .pot templates, sphinx-intl update generates locale/<lang>/LC_MESSAGES/*.po catalogs, msgfmt (GNU gettext) compiles .mo (automatic in make since Sphinx 1.3), 'language' config selects the locale at build; Sphinx own UI strings ship as separate gettext catalogs translated via Transifex. Toolchain burden (GNU gettext + pip sphinx-intl) is the cautionary reference.
